title.zh: 复旦邱锡鹏团队融超10亿，要做《Her》式AI助手
title.en: 复旦邱锡鹏团队融超10亿，要做《Her》式AI助手

current_state.zh: Fudan professor Qiu Xipeng's startup 模思智能 raised over RMB 1 billion in Pre-A funding to build a real-time, emotion- and context-aware multimodal AI assistant (MOSS Live), building on its open-sourced MOSS-Audio and MOSS-VL-Realtime models.
